description: Texts with the silence symbol inside a bracket of DECtalk's phoneme mode: inside a word and at its start and end, after and before a word boundary, with a duration written on it and without, two in a row, before a stop, in a bracket of its own before and between ordinary words. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.
